newUser: Be ye new t' SoulFire? Read the guide fer gettin' started, matey!

connect.title: Hoist yer sails to a SoulFire server
connect.description: Choose which kind o' SoulFire vessel ye wish to board, matey.

integrated.title: Ship computer (local)
integrated.description: Hoist a SoulFire server on this here device. Setup happens automagically. This choice be requirin' the desktop or Android app, arrr.

dedicated.title: Remote server (yonder)
dedicated.description: Links up t' a faraway SoulFire server usin' its address n' secret token, matey.

demo.title: Demo schooner
demo.description: Gives ye a read-only server wit' a stash o' demo loot. No changes be saved by SoulFire, savvy?

integrated.preparing: Preparin' to hoist the integrated server...

toast.error: Blimey! Couldn’t start the local server.

reset.button: Blast the Data Back to Start
reset.success: Arrr! SoulFire booty be reset. Give it another go, ye scallywag.
reset.error: Failed to reset the SoulFire booty, matey!

integrated.description: The integrated server be runnin' on yer own computer, aye. Ye can change the Java startup commands below.

jvmArgs.title: Java VM riggin'
jvmArgs.description: Java VM arguments fer SoulFire. Add <bold>-Xmx4G</bold> if ye want 4 GB o' memory. The default be 25% o' yer available RAM, arrr.
jvmArgs.placeholder: Drop yer own JVM spells here

mobile.description: To set sail on mobile, ye need to do a bit o' handwork first.

termuxCommand.title: Termux spell
termuxCommand.description: Install the Termux app, matey. Then run this command in Termux t' install the SoulFire server. Run generate-token api t' make a new token. After that, toss the token in below, arrr.

token.title: Token
token.description: Secret code to prove ye belong on this here local ship.

dedicated.description: Type the address n' token o' the SoulFire server here, ye scallywag.

toast.error: Cursed wind! Couldn’t board the server.

token.title: Token
token.description: The code to prove ye belong on this server, matey.

email.title: Parrot mail
email.description: The parrot mail of yer SoulFire account.

emailCode.description: If ye be havin' an account, we've sent a code to <bold>{{email}}</bold>. Feed it in below, matey.

toast.error: That code be no good, ye scallywag.

footer.preview: Seekin' the preview version, are ye?
footer.production: Want to cast off to production waters, do ye?
